messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ऐसे ही मेरी आत्मा, जो अभी भी उड़ रही थी, वह पीछे मुड़कर उस पास को फिर से देखने के लिये घुड़ी जिस पास को कभी भी कोई जीवित व्यक्ति नहीं छोड़ा।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | così | resultative adverb “so” linking to previous clause | ऐसे ही | “so / just like that” | OK | | l'animo | noun “the soul” (subject) | आत्मा | “soul” | OK | | mio | possessive adjective “my” | मेरी | “my” | OK | | ch'ancor | relative pronoun + adverb “which still” | जो अभी भी | “which still” | OK | | fuggiva | imperfect verb “was fleeing / flying” | उड़ रही थी | “was flying” | OK | | si | reflexive clitic pronoun (the soul turns itself) | वह | “he / it” (reflexive sense) | OK | | volse | remote‑past verb “turned” | घुड़ी | “turned” | **WRONG** (unnatural lexical choice) | | a (1st) | preposition introducing direction “to” (part of *a retro*) | पीछे | “backward” | OK | | retro | noun used adverbially “back” | पीछे | “backward” | OK | | a (2nd) | preposition introducing purpose “to” (before *rimirar*) | के लिये | “for” | OK | | rimirar | infinitive “to look again” | देखने | “to look” | OK | | lo | definite article “the” (masc.) | उस | “the” | OK | | passo | noun “the pass” (object) | पास | “pass” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | जिस | “which” | OK | | non | negation particle “not” | नहीं | “not” | OK | | lasciò | remote‑past verb “left” | छोड़ा | “left” | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” (emphasises never‑before) | — | — | **MISSING** | | mai | adverb “never” (intensifier) | कभी | “never” | OK | | persona | noun “person” (feminine) | व्यक्ति | “person” | OK | | viva | adjective “living” (agreeing with *persona*) | जीवित | “living” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG:** *volse* → rendered as **घुड़ी**, which is not a standard Hindi verb for “turned”. A more appropriate choice would be **मूड़ी** or **घुड़ी** (if intended as “turned”). - **MISSING:** *già* (“already”) is omitted in the Hindi rendering; the sentence lacks the temporal emphasis present in the source.
No UNNECESSARY or GRAMMAR‑agreement errors were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 25** - Original: ऐसे ही मेरी आत्मा, जो अभी भी उड़ रही थी, - Issue: none - Corrected: ऐसे ही मेरी आत्मा, जो अभी भी उड़ रही थी,
- **Line 26** - Original: वह पीछे मुड़कर उस पास को फिर से देखने के लिये घुड़ी - Issue: WRONG – verb “घुड़ी” is not the proper Hindi verb for “turned”. - Corrected: वह पीछे मुड़कर उस पास को फिर से देखने के लिये मूड़ी
- **Line 27** - Original: जिस पास को कभी भी कोई जीवित व्यक्ति नहीं छोड़ा। - Issue: MISSING – the temporal emphasis “already” (già) is omitted. - Corrected: जिस पास को पहले कभी भी कोई जीवित व्यक्ति नहीं छोड़ा।
